title: Aunt Bev Hasn't LAUGHED in 492 Days 😂
premise: In this town a number floats over everyone's head and everyone says it counts the days since you last laughed. Past 500, your color starts to go. My aunt Bev, the funniest person in our family, laughs all night at league night, and hers says 492.
twist: It counts the days since you made somebody else laugh. Bev's last real laugh was from me, 492 days ago, the day I decided I was too cool for her jokes. A fake laugh doesn't count; what finally gets me is her slipping on the lane like I always do, and her counter rolls to 0 on a strike.
world: a bright bowling alley on league night with glossy maple lanes, teal and pink neon, a glyph scoreboard, a snack bar and a shoe-rental counter
